scope: Original single-pane reader before the proposed three-pane design. Fixed synthetic chapter, 80ms latency, shared 4MiB/s. Visible Chromium rAF intervals are not compositor presentation. Short trials and forced fresh image URLs are not long-term production memory measurements.
notes: Exploration groups have 10 repetitions; their p95 fields are descriptive sample quantiles, not stable tail estimates.
The first warm-stability trial also loads later pages once; subsequent 49 trials transfer zero image bytes.
The opaque reader covers window materials; material results do not establish cost on the catalog or general window interactions.
Same-process repeated cold trials deliberately use distinct image URLs. Chromium decoded-image caches and retained benchmark events contribute to memory.
Temporary overscan variants modify only the work/ build transform. Final product retains overscan=2; no product experiment switch.
